function.text: ACTB encodes actin, cytoplasmic 1 [Cleaved into: Actin, cytoplasmic 1, N-terminally processed]. Annotated molecular activities include ATP hydrolysis activity and transporter regulator activity. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

function.text: ACTB encodes actin, cytoplasmic 1. Based in part on similarity, actin is a highly conserved protein that polymerizes to produce filaments that form cross-linked networks in the cytoplasm of cells. It contributes to the assembly of the gamma-tubulin ring complex (gTuRC), which regulates the minus-end nucleation of alpha-beta tubulin heterodimers that grow into microtubule protafilaments. It forms part of the ACTR1A/ACTB filament around which the dynactin complex is built.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Baraitser-Winter cerebrofrontofacial syndrome (autosomal dominant); Baraitser-Winter syndrome 1 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ACTB have been reported in GLI1-altered mesenchymal tumor, malignant/metastasizing.
